title: Babai Nearest Plane Gram-Schmidt Orthorhombic Radius vs. Coordinate Rounding
claims: For any full-rank lattice basis B, the inscribed L2 ball radius of Babai Coordinate Rounding satisfies r_CR(B) = 1 / (2 max_i ||(B^{-1})_{i,.}||_2) <= r_NP(B) = 0.5 min_i ||b_tilde_i||_2, with strict inequality whenever the minimal row has non-zero Gram-Schmidt coupling.
Target errors with r_CR(B) < ||e||_2 < r_NP(B) inside the Gram-Schmidt box are deterministically decoded by Nearest Plane while overflowing Coordinate Rounding.
